ns2:course.label: Unpacking Intl Experience
ns2:course.description: For students who have recently completed an international experience (study abroad, service learning, fieldwork). Provides students with practical and theoretical tools to reflect upon their international experience and helps them identify the professional and personal skills they acquired while abroad. Explores how cultural values and assumptions shape one?s attitude abroad, and the ways these factors affect cross-cultural interactions between people. Same as GLBL 227.
